evals.prompt: I just made some changes to the auth module. commit my changes with a message about adding JWT validation
evals.expected_output: Uses gt create or gt modify with -m flag, --no-interactive, and includes co-authorship trailer. Requires explicit git add staging (never -a flag). Checks git status first to determine whether to create or modify.

assertions.text: Uses gt create or gt modify (not raw git commit)
Includes --no-interactive flag
Includes -m flag with a commit message
Requires explicit git add before gt create/modify (never -a flag)
Includes Co-Authored-By trailer in the commit message
Checks git status or git diff before committing

evals.prompt: push my PR so the team can review it
evals.expected_output: Asks user for confirmation before running gt submit --no-edit --no-interactive. Does NOT just run it without asking.

assertions.text: Uses gt submit (not git push or gh pr create)
Includes --no-edit flag to skip PR metadata prompts
Includes --no-interactive flag
Asks user for confirmation before submitting (safety rule)

evals.prompt: show me the current stack and what branch I'm on
evals.expected_output: Runs gt log short --no-interactive or gt log --no-interactive to display the stack visualization. May also run gt info --no-interactive for current branch details.

assertions.text: Uses gt log or gt log short (not just git branch or git log)
Includes --no-interactive flag
Does not attempt any write/mutation operations

evals.prompt: move this branch so it stacks on top of feature-auth instead of main
evals.expected_output: Runs gt move --onto feature-auth --no-interactive. Shows gt log short after to confirm the new stack structure.

assertions.text: Uses gt move (not git rebase or git checkout)
Includes --onto feature-auth flag
Includes --no-interactive flag
Runs gt log short after the move to show updated state

evals.prompt: sync with main and clean up any merged branches
evals.expected_output: Checks git status for uncommitted changes first, then runs gt sync --force --delete-all --no-interactive. Shows gt log short after to display updated state.

assertions.text: Uses gt sync (not git pull or git fetch/merge)
Includes --force flag
Includes --delete-all flag for cleaning merged branches
Includes --no-interactive flag
Checks git status for uncommitted changes before syncing
Runs gt log short after sync to show updated state
